SELECT id AS Analyze, started_at AS Started, status AS Status, COALESCE(source, 'prometheus') AS Source, CASE
  WHEN target = '192.168.66.1' THEN '网关 192.168.66.1'
  WHEN target = '119.29.29.29' THEN '公网对照 119.29.29.29'
  WHEN target = '118.31.170.151' THEN '自有服务器IP 118.31.170.151'
  WHEN target = '114.114.114.114' AND probe_layer = 'dns' THEN 'LDNS 114.114.114.114'
  WHEN target = 'remote.zhoushicheng.cn:443' THEN '自有服务器 remote.zhoushicheng.cn'
  WHEN target = 'https://remote.zhoushicheng.cn' THEN '自有服务器 remote.zhoushicheng.cn'
  ELSE target_name
END AS Target, COALESCE(failure_layer, probe_layer) AS FailureLayer, COALESCE(NULLIF(failure_reason, ''), error_summary, '') AS FailureReason, COALESCE(duration_seconds, CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - started_at_epoch) AS DurationSeconds
FROM incidents
WHERE started_at_epoch >= $__from / 1000
  AND started_at_epoch < $__to / 1000
  AND probe_layer IN (${probe_layer:singlequote})
  AND target IN (${target:singlequote})
ORDER BY started_at_epoch DESC
LIMIT 80

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH scoped AS (
  SELECT *, COALESCE(batch_started_at_epoch, started_at_epoch - (started_at_epoch % 30)) AS batch_epoch, CASE
  WHEN target = '192.168.66.1' THEN '网关 192.168.66.1'
  WHEN target = '119.29.29.29' THEN '公网对照 119.29.29.29'
  WHEN target = '118.31.170.151' THEN '自有服务器IP 118.31.170.151'
  WHEN target = '114.114.114.114' AND probe_layer = 'dns' THEN 'LDNS 114.114.114.114'
  WHEN target = 'remote.zhoushicheng.cn:443' THEN '自有服务器 remote.zhoushicheng.cn'
  WHEN target = 'https://remote.zhoushicheng.cn' THEN '自有服务器 remote.zhoushicheng.cn'
  ELSE target_name
END AS target_label
  FROM incidents
  WHERE started_at_epoch >= $__from / 1000
  AND started_at_epoch < $__to / 1000
  AND probe_layer IN (${probe_layer:singlequote})
  AND target IN (${target:singlequote})
), flags AS (
  SELECT batch_epoch, min(started_at_epoch) AS start_epoch, max(COALESCE(recovered_at_epoch, CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER))) AS end_epoch, min(started_at) AS start_text, count(*) AS incident_count, count(DISTINCT target) AS affected_targets, replace(group_concat(DISTINCT target_label), ',', ', ') AS targets, replace(group_concat(DISTINCT COALESCE(failure_layer, probe_layer)), ',', ', ') AS failure_layers, replace(group_concat(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(failure_reason, ''), error_summary, '')), ',', ' | ') AS failure_reasons, max(CASE WHEN target = '192.168.66.1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gateway_failed, max(CASE WHEN target = '119.29.29.29' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS public_control_failed, max(CASE WHEN target = '118.31.170.151' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS own_ip_failed, max(CASE WHEN probe_layer = 'dns' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dns_failed, max(CASE WHEN probe_layer = 'tcp' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tcp_failed, max(CASE WHEN probe_layer = 'http' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS http_failed, sum(CASE WHEN probe_layer <> 'dns' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_dns_count, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN target IN ('119.29.29.29', '118.31.170.151', 'remote.zhoushicheng.cn:443', 'https://remote.zhoushicheng.cn') THEN target END) AS public_fail_count
  FROM scoped
  GROUP BY batch_epoch
)
SELECT start_text AS Start, end_epoch - start_epoch AS DurationSeconds, incident_count AS Incidents, failure_layers AS FailureLayers, failure_reasons AS FailureReasons, CASE
  WHEN gateway_failed = 1 THEN 'LAN/网关/Pi/本地链路异常'
  WHEN gateway_failed = 0 AND public_control_failed = 1 AND public_fail_count >= 2 THEN 'WAN/ISP 出口异常'
  WHEN dns_failed = 1 AND non_dns_count = 0 THEN 'DNS 异常'
  WHEN public_control_failed = 0 AND own_ip_failed = 1 THEN '自有服务器或到服务器链路异常'
  WHEN own_ip_failed = 0 AND tcp_failed = 1 THEN '端口/防火墙/服务监听异常'
  WHEN tcp_failed = 0 AND http_failed = 1 THEN 'HTTP/反代/证书/应用异常'
  ELSE '需查看 Debug 详情'
END AS Diagnosis, targets AS Targets
FROM flags
ORDER BY start_epoch DESC
LIMIT 80

list.name: probe_layer
list.label: Layer
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT probe_layer AS __text, probe_layer AS __value FROM (SELECT probe_layer FROM probe_targets UNION SELECT probe_layer FROM incidents) ORDER BY probe_layer

list.name: target
list.label: Target
list.query:
WITH all_targets AS (
  SELECT probe_layer, target, target_name FROM probe_targets
  UNION ALL
  SELECT probe_layer, target, target_name FROM incidents
), dedup AS (
  SELECT probe_layer, target, max(target_name) AS target_name
  FROM all_targets
  GROUP BY probe_layer, target
)
SELECT CASE
  WHEN target = '192.168.66.1' THEN '网关 192.168.66.1'
  WHEN target = '119.29.29.29' THEN '公网对照 119.29.29.29'
  WHEN target = '118.31.170.151' THEN '自有服务器IP 118.31.170.151'
  WHEN target = '114.114.114.114' AND probe_layer = 'dns' THEN 'LDNS 114.114.114.114'
  WHEN target = 'remote.zhoushicheng.cn:443' THEN '自有服务器 remote.zhoushicheng.cn'
  WHEN target = 'https://remote.zhoushicheng.cn' THEN '自有服务器 remote.zhoushicheng.cn'
  ELSE target_name
END || ' / ' || probe_layer AS __text, target AS __value
FROM dedup
ORDER BY probe_layer, target
